sentences.en: I can't study anywhere in my house. It's too noisy.
sentences.zh: 我家里没法学习。太吵了。

sentences.en: It was so noisy that I couldn't make myself heard.
sentences.zh: 声音太大，我都听不清自己在说什么。

sentences.en: I could not make myself heard in the noisy class.
sentences.zh: 吵闹的课堂里，我都听不清自己在说什么。

senses.zh: 嘈杂的,喧闹的,充满噪音的,吵吵闹闹的n.响声,嘈杂声
